findings.reason: Get and Update RETURNING now propagate existing error_message values into exported Operation fields, but internal/app/recovery.go writes retErr.Error() directly to error_message. Provider Error.Error() includes the raw provider Message or Cause, so this patch can copy and expose provider-controlled or secret-bearing text despite the stated safe-diagnostics contract.
findings.required_change: Ensure every error_message value exposed through Operation is normalized and bounded. Replace raw recovery error persistence with the same static-stage/allowlisted-class/normalized-HTTP representation, or otherwise prevent untrusted historical values from being returned through Operation. Add a PostgreSQL test that seeds a recovery-style provider error containing a secret sentinel and proves Get/Update never returns it.

findings.reason: Several recovery transitions set operations to verifying or succeeded through direct SQL without clearing error_code/error_message. After this patch those columns represent the current outcome, so a successfully adopted, verified, or completed operation can retain and expose a stale capacity/transport failure. SQLStore.Update clearing does not cover these direct updates.
findings.required_change: Atomically clear error_code and error_message in every direct operation transition to running, verifying, or succeeded, including create adoption, delete reissue, recovered success, and completion helpers. Add real PostgreSQL recovery tests proving terminal diagnostics are cleared on each progress transition and remain unchanged when the optimistic version claim loses.
